text:
At [Company], we're rebuilding how freight moves, and data is central to that work. We're a Series A logistics startup with $12M raised and a team of 60 people focused on getting goods where they need to go faster and more reliably. Every shipment, route, and delivery window generates data. We need a Data Engineer to turn that constant flow into something our operators, analysts, and customers can trust.

You'll own core parts of our data platform, built on dbt, Snowflake, and Airflow. You'll design reliable pipelines, build data models that hold up under real operational pressure, and decide what to build now and what can wait. At our size, your work won't get lost in a backlog. It will shape how dispatch teams plan their day and how leadership makes decisions.

We work remotely four days a week and meet in person one day for planning, whiteboarding, and the conversations that go better face to face. If you want hard problems where you can see the impact and a real say in how a data team grows, we'd love to hear from you.
